semantics.identity_rule: Each recovery objective profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.rpo_rule: Recovery Point Objective is explicit where applicable.
semantics.rto_rule: Recovery Time Objective is explicit where applicable.
semantics.dependency_rule: Critical dependency recovery ordering is explicit.
semantics.measurement_rule: Objective attainment is measured from exact evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Objective does not authorize destructive recovery.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
